crossRefs.note: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of…
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

translations.web: and I will give him the morning star.
